section_title:
Notwithstanding anything contained in any other law for the time being in Admissibility
force,— of micro
films,
(a) a micro film of a document or the reproduction of the image or images embodied facsimile
in such micro film (whether enlarged or not); or copies of
documents and
(b) a facsimile copy of a document; or computer
printouts as
(c) a statement contained in a document and included in a printed material documents and
produced by a computer, subject to such conditions as may be prescribed; or as evidence.
